_README: Extra animation clips for the bot rig: clip name -> file, loaded by
loadBotAnimations() in src/main.js at boot, before the first Bot is built.
Recognised names are listed in BOT_CLIP_NAMES (src/bots.js); anything else is ignored.
These came from mixamo.com, exported as FBX, WITHOUT SKIN, and with In Place ticked on
every locomotion clip - the bots are moved by physics, so a clip carrying root motion
makes them slide. Death has no In Place option and does not need one.
Sources: Rifle Idle / Rifle Walk / Rifle Run / Strafe Left (Rifle Walk Strafe Left) /
Strafe Right (Rifle Walk Strafe Right) / Walking Backwards (While Aiming Rifle) /
Idle Crouching Aiming / Dying (Shot To The Chest Falling On Two Knees).
Retargeting is by track name and the rig is stock Mixamo, so no bone remapping is
needed - but three's FBXLoader strips the colon from 'mixamorig:Hips', so the loader
puts it back. Without that, every track binds to nothing and the clips silently do
